an6.59:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā nādike viharati giñjakāvasathe.
an6.59:1.3: atha kho dārukammiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho dārukammikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an6.59:1.4: api nu te gahapati kule dānaṃ dīyatīti.
an6.59:1.6: tañca kho ye te bhikkhū āraññakā piṇḍapātikā paṃsukulikā arahantā vā arahattamaggaṃ vā samāpannā tathārūpesu bhante bhikkhūsu dānaṃ dīyatīti.
an6.59:2.1: dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ gahapati tayā gihinā kāmabhoginā puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasantena kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhontena mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārayantena jātarūparajataṃ sādiyantena ime vā arahanto ime vā arahattamaggaṃ samāpannāti
an6.59:3.1: āraññako cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti uddhato unnaḷo capalo mukharo vikiṇṇavāco muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākaṭindriyo
an6.59:3.3: āraññako cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti anuddhato anunnaḷo acapalo amukharo avikiṇṇavāco upaṭṭhitassati sampajāno samāhito ekaggacitto saṃvutindriyo

an6.59:8.1: gahapaticīvaradharo cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti uddhato unnaḷo capalo mukharo vikiṇṇavāco muṭṭhassati asampajāno asamāhito vibbhantacitto pākaṭindriyo
an6.59:8.3: gahapaticīvaradharo cepi gahapati bhikkhu hoti anuddhato anunnaḷo acapalo amukharo avikiṇṇavāco upaṭṭhitasati sampajāno samāhito ekaggacitto saṃvutindriyo
an6.59:9.1: iṅgha tvaṃ gahapati saṅghe dānaṃ dehi
an6.59:9.2: saṅghe te dānaṃ dadato cittaṃ pasīdissati
an6.59:9.3: so tvaṃ pasannacitto kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissasīti.
an6.59:9.4: esāhaṃ bhante ajjatagge saṅghe dānāni dassāmīti.
